scope: Deliberate learner-facing senses only. This does not validate whole-passage linguistic/pedagogical quality or educator/publication release readiness.
canonical_freshness_method: Each final target ID was searched against the complete canonical Urdu A1 and canonical Urdu A2 through Unit 8 new_lexical_targets and was absent as a prior deliberate target before Unit 9.
